text: Doors shall not open while vehicle speed is greater than 5.0 km/h.
If an obstacle is detected while the doors are closing they shall reopen.
Three consecutive frames with an invalid CRC shall put the controller in FAULT.
If no valid speed frame is received for more than 500 ms the controller shall enter FAULT.
Unknown command values shall be rejected without a state change.
Door state transitions shall follow the specified state machine.
